plain_text:
In October Getty President and CEO Katherine E. Fleming
hosted the seventh annual President's Dinner at the Getty
Center. She expressed gratitude to donors for the myriad ways
their philanthropic support is expanding the horizons of possi-
bility at Getty. She also toasted the international partners in
attendance, including representatives of the International Alli-
ance for the Protection of Heritage in Conflict Areas. Guests
enjoyed dinner in the Museum Entrance Hall beneath Mercedes
Dorme's spectacular installation Woshua'axre Yaang'aro
(Looking Back), Board of Trustees Chair Rob Lovelace closed
the evening by warmly thanking attendees for their generosity
and engagement in moving Getty forward as a globally impact-
ful institution.
